annotations.text:
TenderSense - BD team console

IBM Plex Sans / Mono. Ink #15181c on #f5f5f2, one accent #0f4f4a.
Grades are a single-hue intensity ramp, not a rainbow: S solid, A tinted, B/C muted.
Colour carries only three meanings - eligible, verify, urgent.

Alternative to screen 1.

Main = scan and compare, 10 rows at a glance.
Direction B = decide one at a time, evidence inline, bigger targets.

Pick one before Track C starts building - they share every other screen.

Real measured figures: match scores, grade thresholds (p98 0.4106 / p90 0.3445),
corpus counts, run timings, and the 0.200 benchmark tie.

Sample values: procuring entities and some tender subtitles.
The capability profile and the benchmark labels are both placeholders -
flagged on screens 3 and 4.
